AT THE END OF YOUR INTERNSHIP, YOU WILL HAVE LEARNED TO - Plan, execute and optimise multi-channel CRM and lifecycle marketing campaigns - Use data and customer insights to improve engagement, activation and retention - Work with campaign segmentation, personalisation, marketing automation, experimentation and performance analysis - Collaborate with local and global marketing teams in an international environment.
